provenance.note: native venue, no debugger: start-uut.sh prints the host name in the place of the debugger serial

notes: `deployment` is the instance prefix fth puts before the plan's command names (`cmdDisp`, `version` and `tlmSend` are CdhCore instances). No `boot_event`: the plan commands `version.VERSION`, so no version event is logged once per boot only; a restart of the Ref process closes the TCP link and the run stops. Venue A: Ref on a Linux host, fprime-gds over TCP. Relative paths only: run from the campaign root, which holds `uut-ref/` (lestarch-autobot/fprime, branch tlm-packetizer-membership-pool-harness, built). `serial` is the bench host's name.
